name: Debrid-Link sign-in
description: Signs a Debrid-Link account in through the provider, without an API key being typed here.

codes.debridlink_auth.consent_denied: The provider refused the sign-in for this account.
codes.debridlink_auth.sign_in_refused: The provider refused the sign-in. Start it again.
codes.debridlink_auth.bad_reply: The provider sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.debridlink_auth.flow_expired: The sign-in code expired before it was confirmed.
